::: {.flashcard data-card-id="ir362-18"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
Define **the carousel** in Hammad's framing.
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-18','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-18','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
A Nash-equilibrium pattern where each actor best-responds; cycles of escalation/de-escalation produce the *appearance* of motion while the structure stays intact. Only payoff-matrix shocks shift it.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="ir362-19"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Primacy vs. hegemony** — the one-sentence test
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-19','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-19','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Primacy = preponderant material power. Hegemony = the ability to set the rules others follow. The US has had the first; it never had the second in MENA (Gause).
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="ir362-20"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
What makes the **Abraham Accords** a *sequencing inversion*?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-20','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-20','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
The API put a Palestinian state *first*, normalization second. The Accords reverse the order: normalization first, with the Palestinian question demoted to "later." Same actors, inverted dependency.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="ir362-21"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
Why did **Assad fall** in 2024 — single-cause vs. structural answer?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-21','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'ir362-21','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Not "HTS won." **Four scaffolds failed simultaneously**: Hezbollah (post-Nasrallah), IRGC (post-Soleimani-doctrine), Russian air (Ukraine drain), regime army (rotted). The HTS push only mattered because the props were gone.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard-back}

Tehran connected the Gulf-security sphere to the Israeli-Lebanese sphere via **Hezbollah + Syria's geographic land bridge**. Structurally central until 12/2024; functionally diminished after.

:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard-grid data-deck="econ205"}

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-01"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Spending GDP** — write the identity, including NX expansion
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-01','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-01','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$Y = C + I + G + NX$, with $NX = X - M$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-02"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Fisher equation** (exact and approximate)
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-02','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-02','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Exact: $1+i = (1+r)(1+\pi^e)$. Approx: $i \approx r + \pi^e$, so $r \approx i - \pi^e$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-03"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Quantity equation** + the long-run quantity-theory implication
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-03','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-03','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$M \cdot V = P \cdot Y$. With V, Y stable in LR: $\%\Delta M \approx \pi$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-04"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Spending and tax multipliers** (closed economy)
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-04','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-04','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Spending: $\frac{1}{1-MPC}$. Tax: $\frac{-MPC}{1-MPC}$. Balanced budget = 1.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-05"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Open-economy multiplier** with proportional tax t and import propensity m
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-05','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-05','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$\frac{1}{1 - MPC(1-t) + m}$. Imports leak → multiplier shrinks.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-06"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Okun's Law** (rule of thumb)
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-06','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-06','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$\Delta u \approx -0.5 \cdot (\text{real GDP gap growth})$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-07"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Real exchange rate** and **PPP** in the long run
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-07','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-07','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$\varepsilon = E \cdot P / P^*$. PPP (LR): $E = P^*/P$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-08"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Saving identity** in an open economy
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-08','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-08','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$S = I + NX$, equivalently $S - I = NX$ (capital outflow = trade surplus).
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-09"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**GDP deflator** and inflation rate from it
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-09','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-09','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$\text{Def} = \frac{\text{Nominal}}{\text{Real}} \times 100$; $\pi = \frac{\text{Def}_t - \text{Def}_{t-1}}{\text{Def}_{t-1}}$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-10"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Cobb-Douglas** with $Y=AK^{0.5}L^{0.5}$ — what happens if K alone doubles?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-10','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-10','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$Y$ rises by $\sqrt{2}$ (diminishing marginal returns). If both K and L double → Y doubles (CRS).
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-11"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Demand shock** in AD/AS — how do P and Y co-move?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-11','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-11','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Same direction.** AD↓ → P↓ and Y↓ (recession with disinflation). AD↑ → P↑ and Y↑.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-12"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Supply (SRAS) shock** — how do P and Y move?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-12','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-12','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Opposite directions.** SRAS↓ → P↑, Y↓, u↑ (stagflation).
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-13"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Long-run self-correction** after an AD shift — what restores Y*?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-13','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-13','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**SRAS shifts** as wages/prices adjust until output returns to potential. LRAS is vertical at $Y^*$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-14"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Loanable funds** — government deficit shifts which curve, and what happens to r and I?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-14','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-14','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Deficit → **supply of loanable funds shifts left** (S↓) → **r↑**, private **I↓** = **crowding out**.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-15"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Fed buys bonds** — trace AD/AS to P, Y
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-15','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-15','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Reserves↑ → fed funds rate↓ → r↓ → I↑, C↑, NX↑ (via $ depreciation) → **AD shifts right** → P↑, Y↑.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-16"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Tariff** vs. **quota** — what's the rectangle, who gets it?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-16','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-16','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Tariff: rectangle is **government revenue**. Quota: identical-shape rectangle is **license-holder rent**. Two DWL triangles either way.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-17"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Model]{.label}
::: {.q}
$ **appreciates** — what happens to X, M, NX?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-17','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-17','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
US exports more expensive abroad → **X↓**; foreign goods cheaper here → **M↑** → **NX↓**. Appreciation hurts exporters.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-18"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
If the Fed **raises** the fed funds rate, what happens to bond prices and asset values?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-18','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-18','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Bond prices fall** (price ↔ yield inverse). Asset prices generally fall via PV discounting. Investment demand falls.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-19"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Comparative advantage** — what's the basis (and the trap)?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-19','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-19','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Lowest **opportunity cost** — NOT lowest absolute cost. Both nations gain by specializing in their CA good and trading at terms-of-trade between the two opportunity-cost ratios.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-20"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Interest-rate parity** — direction of capital flows and currency
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-20','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-20','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Capital flows to the **higher-r country** → that country's currency **appreciates** until expected returns equalize.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-21"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
Why is the **tax multiplier smaller** than the spending multiplier in absolute value?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-21','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-21','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
A tax cut adds income; only the MPC fraction is spent on the **first round**. G is direct purchases — full first-round impact.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-22"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Fisher direction** — common error to avoid
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-22','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-22','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Don't confuse *ex ante* (uses $\pi^e$) with *ex post* (uses realized $\pi$). When π unexpectedly **rises**, real rate **falls** — wealth redistributes from creditors to debtors.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-23"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
Define **crowding out** in one sentence
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-23','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-23','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Government borrowing pushes up real interest rates, reducing private investment (and via $ appreciation, NX) — partially offsetting fiscal expansion.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-24"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Quantity theory** — confusing $\Delta M$ with $\%\Delta M$. Which one maps to π?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-24','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-24','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Percent change** in M maps to inflation: $\%\Delta M \approx \pi$ in the long run when V, Y are stable.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="econ205-25"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Automatic stabilizers** — give two and explain mechanism
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-25','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'econ205-25','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Progressive taxes** + **unemployment insurance**. Tax revenue falls and transfers rise during downturns — dampens cycles without legislative action.
:::
:::
:::
:::

:::

## ACCT 410x

::: {.deck-stats id="stats-acct410x"}
0 / 25 mastered
:::

::: {.deck-controls}
<button onclick="fcReset('acct410x')">Reset deck</button>
<button onclick="fcShowOnly('acct410x','missed')">Show missed only</button>
<button onclick="fcShowOnly('acct410x','all')">Show all</button>
:::

::: {.flashcard-grid data-deck="acct410x"}

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-01"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
State the **accounting equation** and the equity expansion
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-01','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-01','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$Assets = Liabilities + Equity$. Equity = Contributed Capital + Retained Earnings.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-02"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Retained Earnings** roll-forward
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-02','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-02','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$RE_{end} = RE_{begin} + Net~Income - Dividends$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-03"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**COGS equation** from inventory flow
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-03','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-03','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$COGS = Beginning~Inv + Purchases - Ending~Inv$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-04"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Current ratio** and **inventory turnover**
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-04','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-04','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Current = $CA / CL$. Inventory turnover = $COGS / Avg~Inventory$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-05"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Profit margin** and **ROA**
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-05','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-05','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Profit Margin = $NI / Net~Sales$. ROA = $NI / Avg~Total~Assets$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-06"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Debt-to-Assets** ratio
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-06','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-06','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$Total~Liabilities / Total~Assets$. Solvency / leverage measure.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-07"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Straight-line depreciation**
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-07','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-07','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$(Cost - Salvage) / Useful~Life$ per year.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-08"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Contribution margin** and **CM ratio**
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-08','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-08','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
CM = $Sales - Variable~Costs$. CM ratio = $Unit~CM / Unit~Price$ (or total CM / total sales).
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-09"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Break-even units** and **target-profit units**
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-09','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-09','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
BE units = $FC / Unit~CM$. Target = $(FC + Target~Profit) / Unit~CM$.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-10"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Formula]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Net income** in one identity
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-10','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-10','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
$NI = Revenues - Expenses$. Flows into RE.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-11"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Normal balance** of Assets, Dividends, Expenses?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-11','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-11','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Debit** (mnemonic: **ADE**). Debits increase, credits decrease.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-12"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Normal balance** of Liabilities, Equity, Revenue?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-12','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-12','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Credit** (mnemonic: **LER**). Credits increase, debits decrease.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-13"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Accrual vs. cash** basis — one-line distinction
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-13','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-13','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Accrual recognizes revenue when **earned** and expense when **incurred** (matching). Cash recognizes only when money moves.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-14"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**FIFO vs. LIFO** in **rising-price** environment — which gives higher NI? Higher ending inventory?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-14','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-14','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**FIFO**: lower COGS → higher NI; ending inv reflects current (higher) costs. **LIFO**: higher COGS → lower NI and lower taxes; ending inv reflects old (lower) costs.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-15"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Relevant costs** for a decision — what to ignore, what to include
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-15','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-15','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Ignore**: sunk costs, allocated fixed costs that don't change. **Include**: incremental revenues, variable costs, opportunity costs.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-16"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
On the **liquidity** vs. **solvency** distinction — which ratios live where?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-16','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-16','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Liquidity (short-term): Current ratio, Inventory turnover. Solvency (long-term): Debt-to-Assets. Profitability is its own bucket: Profit margin, ROA.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-17"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Concept]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Why** does depreciation get added back on the indirect cash-flow statement?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-17','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-17','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
It's a **non-cash expense** that reduced NI. The cash already left in an earlier period (when the asset was bought). Add it back to reconcile NI to cash from operations.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-18"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Indirect method** — direction rules for current-asset and current-liability changes
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-18','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-18','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Asset ↑ = Subtract**, asset ↓ = Add. **Liability ↑ = Add**, liability ↓ = Subtract. Add back **Losses**, subtract **Gains**.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-19"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Multi-product CVP** — what's the trick when product mix matters?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-19','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-19','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Use a **weighted-average CM** (or weighted CM ratio) based on the sales mix. BE units in mix = FC / Weighted-Avg Unit CM. Then split by mix percentages.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-20"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Inventory error reversal** — if you overstate ending inventory in Year 1, what happens to NI in Year 1 vs Year 2?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-20','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-20','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
Year 1 NI is **overstated** (COGS understated). Year 2 begins with overstated beginning inventory → COGS overstated → Year 2 NI **understated**. Errors **reverse** over two years; cumulative RE is correct by end of Year 2.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-21"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Bond pricing direction** — when market rate > coupon rate, the bond sells at?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-21','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-21','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**Discount** (price < face). Market rate < coupon → **premium**. Market rate = coupon → par. Carrying value drifts toward face over the bond's life.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-22"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Trap]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Allocated fixed costs** — why is it a trap to include them in keep/drop decisions?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-22','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-22','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
They don't disappear when you drop the segment — they get reallocated. Only **avoidable** fixed costs are relevant. Including allocated FC fakes "losses" that aren't real cash differences.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.flashcard data-card-id="acct410x-23"}
::: {.flashcard-inner}
::: {.flashcard-front}
[Statements]{.label}
::: {.q}
**Unearned Revenue collected $10k cash** — flow through three statements?
:::
::: {.actions}
<button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-23','got')">Got it ✓</button><button onclick="fcMark(event,'acct410x-23','missed')">Missed ✗</button>
:::
:::
::: {.flashcard-back}
[Answer]{.label}
::: {.a}
**BS**: Cash +$10k, Unearned Rev (liability) +$10k. **IS**: no impact yet (not earned). **CF**: Operating +$10k (cash inflow). Recognize revenue later when earned: liability ↓, Revenue ↑, NI ↑.
:::
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  const STORE_KEY = 'studyhub_flashcards_v1';
  function load(){ try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY)||'{}'); } catch(e){ return {}; } }
  function save(s){ localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }

  function deckOf(card){
    const grid = card.closest('.flashcard-grid');
    return grid ? grid.dataset.deck : null;
  }
  function allCardsOf(deck){
    return document.querySelectorAll('.flashcard-grid[data-deck="'+deck+'"] .flashcard');
  }

  function applyState(){
    const s = load();
    document.querySelectorAll('.flashcard').forEach(card => {
      const id = card.dataset.cardId;
      card.classList.remove('got-it','missed');
      const badge = card.querySelector('.status-badge');
      if (badge) badge.remove();
      if (s[id] === 'got'){
        card.classList.add('got-it');
        const b = document.createElement('div');
        b.className = 'status-badge'; b.textContent = '✓ got';
        card.appendChild(b);
      } else if (s[id] === 'missed'){
        card.classList.add('missed');
        const b = document.createElement('div');
        b.className = 'status-badge'; b.textContent = '✗ missed';
        card.appendChild(b);
      }
    });
    ['ir362','econ205','acct410x'].forEach(updateStats);
  }

  function updateStats(deck){
    const cards = allCardsOf(deck);
    const s = load();
    let got = 0;
    cards.forEach(c => { if (s[c.dataset.cardId] === 'got') got++; });
    const el = document.getElementById('stats-'+deck);
    if (el) el.textContent = got + ' / ' + cards.length + ' mastered';
  }

  window.fcMark = function(ev, id, kind){
    ev.stopPropagation();
    const s = load();
    if (s[id] === kind) delete s[id]; else s[id] = kind;
    save(s);
    applyState();
  };

  window.fcReset = function(deck){
    if (!confirm('Reset all progress for the '+deck+' deck?')) return;
    const s = load();
    allCardsOf(deck).forEach(c => { delete s[c.dataset.cardId]; });
    save(s);
    // also unflip
    allCardsOf(deck).forEach(c => c.classList.remove('flipped'));
    applyState();
  };

  window.fcShowOnly = function(deck, mode){
    const s = load();
    allCardsOf(deck).forEach(c => {
      const st = s[c.dataset.cardId];
      if (mode === 'all') c.style.display = '';
      else if (mode === 'missed') c.style.display = (st === 'missed') ? '' : 'none';
    });
  };

  function init(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.flashcard').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        if (e.target.closest('button')) return;
        card.classList.toggle('flipped');
      });
    });
    applyState();
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else { init(); }
})();
</script>
```
